---
title: "optimise a glider for trimmed glide. It is constructed of foam 5mm thick density 174.4g/m^2, with a fixed 300mm span and a sensibly sized, fixed tail"
---

{{< include _model.qmd >}}

```{python}
import aerosandbox as asb
import aerosandbox.numpy as np

opti = asb.Opti()

span = 0.300
foam_areal_density = 0.1744

tail_span = 0.100
tail_chord = 0.030
tail_area = tail_span * tail_chord

wing_root_chord = opti.variable(init_guess=0.05, lower_bound=0.01, upper_bound=0.15)
wing_tip_chord = opti.variable(init_guess=0.03, lower_bound=0.01, upper_bound=0.15)
wing_station = opti.variable(init_guess=0.1, lower_bound=0.0, upper_bound=0.3)
tail_station = opti.variable(init_guess=0.3, lower_bound=0.1, upper_bound=0.6)
ballast_mass = opti.variable(init_guess=0.005, lower_bound=0.0, upper_bound=0.05)
tail_incidence = opti.variable(init_guess=-2.0, lower_bound=-10.0, upper_bound=10.0)

nose_station = 0.0
alpha = opti.variable(init_guess=5.0, lower_bound=-5.0, upper_bound=15.0)
velocity = opti.variable(init_guess=5.0, lower_bound=1.0, upper_bound=20.0)

wing = asb.Wing(
    name="Wing", symmetric=True,
    xsecs=[
        asb.WingXSec(xyz_le=[wing_station, 0, 0], chord=wing_root_chord, airfoil=asb.Airfoil("naca0000")),
        asb.WingXSec(xyz_le=[wing_station, span / 2, 0], chord=wing_tip_chord, airfoil=asb.Airfoil("naca0000"))
    ]
)
tail = asb.Wing(
    name="Tail", symmetric=True,
    xsecs=[
        asb.WingXSec(xyz_le=[tail_station, 0, 0], chord=tail_chord, twist=tail_incidence, airfoil=asb.Airfoil("naca0000")),
        asb.WingXSec(xyz_le=[tail_station, tail_span / 2, 0], chord=tail_chord, twist=tail_incidence, airfoil=asb.Airfoil("naca0000"))
    ]
)

wing_area = (wing_root_chord + wing_tip_chord) / 2 * span
wing_mass = wing_area * foam_areal_density
tail_mass = tail_area * foam_areal_density

wing_cg_x = wing_station + 0.5 * wing_root_chord 
tail_cg_x = tail_station + 0.5 * tail_chord

total_mass = wing_mass + tail_mass + ballast_mass
cg_x = (wing_mass * wing_cg_x + tail_mass * tail_cg_x + ballast_mass * nose_station) / total_mass

airplane = asb.Airplane(name="Glider", wings=[wing, tail], xyz_ref=[cg_x, 0, 0])

op0 = asb.OperatingPoint(velocity=velocity, alpha=alpha)
op1 = asb.OperatingPoint(velocity=velocity, alpha=alpha + 1.0)
aero0 = asb.AeroBuildup(airplane=airplane, op_point=op0).run()
aero1 = asb.AeroBuildup(airplane=airplane, op_point=op1).run()

q = op0.dynamic_pressure()
S = airplane.s_ref

CL0 = aero0["L"] / (q * S)
CL1 = aero1["L"] / (q * S)
dCm = aero1["Cm"] - aero0["Cm"]
dCL = CL1 - CL0
sm = - dCm / dCL

opti.subject_to([
    aero0["L"] == total_mass * 9.81,
    aero0["Cm"] == 0,
    sm == 0.10,
    tail_station >= wing_station + wing_root_chord + 0.05
])

sink_rate = velocity * aero0["D"] / aero0["L"]
opti.minimize(sink_rate)

sol = opti.solve(verbose=False)

sink_rate_val = sol.value(sink_rate)
v_val = sol.value(velocity)
tip_val = sol.value(wing_tip_chord) * 1000
root_val = sol.value(wing_root_chord) * 1000
station_val = sol.value(wing_station)
ballast_val = sol.value(ballast_mass) * 1000
incidence_val = sol.value(tail_incidence)
```

::: {.hero}
[`{python} f"{sink_rate_val:.2f}"` m/s]{.hero-value}
[minimum sink rate]{.hero-label}
:::

**Answer.** The optimizer finds a lifting-tail configuration that achieves a sink rate of `{python} f"{sink_rate_val:.2f}"` m/s at a flight speed of `{python} f"{v_val:.1f}"` m/s. To minimize structural weight, the wing tip chord hits its lower bound of `{python} f"{tip_val:.0f}"` mm, while the root chord expands to `{python} f"{root_val:.0f}"` mm. The wing is positioned far back (`{python} f"{station_val:.2f}"` m) to maximize the nose ballast moment arm, requiring only `{python} f"{ballast_val:.1f}"` g of ballast. The tail trims at `{python} f"{incidence_val:+.1f}"`° incidence to balance the wing's lift acting ahead of the center of gravity.
